slots.notes: The four character-figurine collectibles that rotate through the carousel roles (center / left / right / back). Each renders as an inside a 0.6/1 aspect-ratio box with objectFit:contain, objectPosition:bottom center, draggable=false, so the subject must be a transparent (alpha) cutout that stands on the floor of the screen and overlaps the giant ghost text behind it. Order matters: the carousel steps (idx+1)%4 / (idx+3)%4 and each image is data-paired with a stage background color + panel color in the inline IMAGES array (see reskinNotes), so item N's hue must read against its paired bg. The center figurine is scaled 1.68x on desktop (1.25x mobile) and must hold detail when enlarged; back/left/right are blurred 2-4px and small.

Display face for the giant ghost '3D SHAPE' headline (fontSize clamp(90px,28vw,380px), weight 900, uppercase, white) sitting behind the figurines, and for the bottom-right 'DISCOVER IT' link (clamp(20px,4vw,56px), weight 400). Native family: Anton (single weight, ultra-condensed). Loaded from Google Fonts in index.html head. Layout is font-metric dependent: the ghost word is sized in viewport units with letterSpacing -0.02em and whiteSpace:nowrap, so a wider replacement face overflows the viewport.

Sans/body face for the top-left brand label ('TOONHUB'), the bottom-left product line + testimonial paragraph, and the outer container's base fontFamily. Native family: Inter (weights 400/500/600/700). Loaded from Google Fonts in index.html head.

ArrowLeft and ArrowRight from lucide-react, reused twice: as the two circular prev/next carousel buttons (size 26, strokeWidth 2.25, inside w-12/h-12 -> sm w-16/h-16 transparent circles with a 2px white border) and as the trailing arrow on the bottom-right 'DISCOVER IT' link (w-5/h-5 -> sm w-8/h-8, strokeWidth 2.25). Rendered in the fg color (white); themeable via stroke / currentColor.

Full-bleed film-grain texture layered over everything (absolute inset-0, zIndex 50, container opacity 0.4, backgroundSize 200px 200px, repeat). Authored procedurally as an inline SVG fractalNoise data URI (baseFrequency 0.9, numOctaves 4, internal opacity 0.08), NOT a swappable raster asset. Optional socket: a brand could substitute a custom grain/noise tile, otherwise the procedural default stands.

mechanic: Clicking the prev/next arrows rotates four figurines through center/left/right/back carousel roles while the full-viewport background color and every item's transform, scale, blur, and opacity crossfade simultaneously over a 650ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) transition locked behind an isAnimating flag, with the active figurine standing over a giant ghost-text headline.
techDelivery: Single-component React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS with lucide-react icons; Google Fonts (Anton + Inter) linked in index.html head; all motion is inline-style CSS transitions (no animation library).
reskinNotes: Stage background is NOT a single declared hex but a 4-entry palette baked into the inline IMAGES array: each figurine is paired with a bg hex (#F4845F orange, #6BBF7A green, #E882B4 pink, #6EB5FF blue) plus a lighter panel hex (#F79B7F, #85CC92, #ED9DC4, #8DC4FF), and the outer div's backgroundColor is set to IMAGES[activeIndex].bg. The four colorRoles here only sample that array (bg/accent/accent2 = entries 0/1/3; pink #E882B4 and all four panel hexes have no colorRole), so a true retint means editing the array, not the skin block (the panel hexes are declared but unused in the markup). The figurine PNG URLs are hardcoded into that same IMAGES array (figma.site placeholder host) and are the image asset sockets. All copy ('TOONHUB', '3D SHAPE' ghost word, 'TOONHUB FIGURINES', the testimonial paragraph, 'DISCOVER IT') is hardcoded in JSX. The grain overlay is a procedural fractalNoise SVG data URI inlined as a backgroundImage. Every white text/border/icon uses literal white or white-rgba values inline rather than a CSS variable. The ghost headline + DISCOVER link are font-metric dependent (clamp + viewport sizing + negative letter-spacing) so a non-condensed replacement face overflows. The 640px mobile breakpoint (isMobile = innerWidth < 640) drives large branches of the role styling in JS, so responsive geometry is logic-coupled, not purely CSS-overridable.
